text.content:
The people who invented the neuroport.

Industry: Cybernetics
Leadership: Jacinda Hidalgo, CEO
Known for: The neuroport, the central operating system nearly all cyberware now runs through

An American cybernetics company. Its CEO, Jacinda Hidalgo, is a committed transhumanist who pushed her engineers to imagine one mind running many bodies. That dream didn't work, but the central control system it needed did: the neuroport, which bigger corps soon copied.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.8
